description:
Blueprint tracker: what you've unlocked, scrap spent and what's left. The blueprint tracker page (https://rust.wiki/calculators/blueprints) for a list of blueprints you have: per
unlock source (`Research Table`, `Workbench Level N - Tech Tree`, `Tech Tree`) how many are unlocked, the scrap
spent and the scrap left, plus the cheapest ones still locked. Totals count per source like the page (an item
learnable in two places counts twice). `page` opens the tracker with the same ticks. The full list is
/calculators/blueprints. Give the user the page link: it opens the tracker with their blueprints ticked.

remaining.description: How many still-locked blueprints to list per unlock source (cheapest first).

unlocked.description: Comma-separated shortnames (or names) of the blueprints you have. Left out = nothing unlocked yet.

name: track_blueprints
title: Blueprint tracker: what you've unlocked, scrap spent and what's left
